name: wolfram
description: Wolfram Alpha computational knowledge engine. Use for math, physics constants, unit conversions, symbolic computation, and authoritative scientific facts. Mode 'short' = single-line answer; 'llm' = LLM-optimized plaintext (best for facts); 'full' = structured JSON pods.

query.description: Natural-language or symbolic query, e.g. 'integrate sin(x)^2 from 0 to pi' or 'mass of proton in MeV'.
